title: Fresh-Water and Holding-Tank Levels
dataSources: NMEA/SignalK data (`nmea:reading`), bilge pump (`bilge:event`), mooring/anchor watch (`mooring:status`), marine weather (`marineweather:forecast`).
app: Marine electronics — NMEA 2000 / SignalK boat networks, bilge, battery and shore-power sensors, anchor-watch GPS, and marine weather feeds — streamed to Splunk HEC via SignalK and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nmea:reading measurement=tank
| stats latest(level_pct) as level by tank
| eval alert=case(tank="freshwater" AND level<20,"refill water",tank="holding" AND level>80,"pump out soon",1=1,"ok")
| where alert!="ok"
description: Tracks fresh-water and waste holding-tank levels so you refill or pump out before either becomes a problem.
value: Running out of water or overfilling the holding tank ruins a trip; level alerts keep the essentials sorted.
implementation: Ingest tank sensors into `index=personal`; alert on low water or high holding-tank levels.
visualization: Gauges of fresh-water and holding-tank levels.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks the boat's water and waste tanks so you top up or empty them before they cause trouble.
